AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
